data.name: MythicMonsterOutlaws
data.detailed_description:
The End-Game is the Only Game Forget the campaign, the fetch quests, and the hundreds of hours of mandatory leveling. In Mythic Monster Outlaws, you start at the pinnacle of your power. Whether you prefer the coordinated chaos of a 10-man raid or the high-stakes intensity of 3v3 arena combat, you are always just one click away from the action.

Build Variety over Power Creep Drawing inspiration from the deep customization of classic ARPGs and the horizontal progression of competitive shooters, our loot system is designed for parity.

  • Unlock, Don't Outlevel: New loot grants you new ways to play—active skills, passive modifiers, and unique weapon archetypes—rather than raw stat increases.

  • Skill-Based Combat: A veteran player has more tools in their kit, but a new player has the same mathematical chance to win. Victory is determined by your build synergy and your mechanical execution.

Key Features:

  • Full Combat Suite: Queue immediately for instanced PvE Dungeons, massive Raids, and a variety of PvP modes including Battlegrounds and Arenas.

  • Limitless Theorycrafting: Combine hundreds of weapons, armor pieces, and skill gems to create a build that suits your specific playstyle.

  • Competitive Ecosystem: Every activity is tied to a global leaderboard. Track your performance in DPS, healing, objectives, or kill-counts.

  • Prestigious Rewards: Earn exclusive character skins, titles, and visual effects that prove your mastery. High-tier rewards are locked behind top 1% leaderboard placements and difficult seasonal achievements.

  • Zero Barrier to Entry: No pay-to-win mechanics and no time-gating. The only thing standing between you and the top of the ladder is your skill.

data.short_description: Skip the grind and dive into an MMO focused entirely on skill-based PvP and PvE combat. Unlock weapons and skills to expand your build variety, not your power. Competitive leaderboards, instanced raids, and fast-paced arenas—mythic combat starts the moment you create a character.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
